name: How should I prepare my home before shower tile installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before shower tile installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the installation team arrives, clear all toiletries, hanging caddies, shower curtains, and towels from the bathroom. Ensure a clear pathway from the exterior entryway to the bathroom so workers can safely carry heavy tools, cement board, and boxes of tile. It helps to finalize your tile layout pattern, grout color, and fixture placements—such as niche height and grab bars—before demolition begins. If your home has a single full bathroom, prepare alternative accommodations for at least three to four days while the mortar, grout, and waterproofing cure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remove all personal items from the bathroom, clear a walkway for equipment, confirm your tile pattern and niche layout, and plan alternative bathing arrangements.
